title: Criterion: 30 Years of Continuous Evolution and our Future as a Battlefield Studio
description: Join Criterion - the studio behind Burnout, Need For Speed and BLACK - for a session focused on their 30 years of continuous evolution, their place as a modern British creative powerhouse, and how it has navigated genres and developed for multiple platforms. This all now culminates in them being a leading pillar of Battlefield Studios focused on the future of this iconic franchise, that all started with the launch of Battlefield 6, the biggest-selling shooter of 2025.
session_takeaway: Understand how Criterion has evolved alongside the gaming industry over 30 years across multiple hardware generations.
Insights into how Criterion adapted across genres and creative challenges while keeping their bold thinking.
A look at how the collaborative model across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect shapes the Battlefield franchise.
Key career advice for young people looking to enter the gaming industry in 2026.
